_comment: Third-party binaries that go into the installed application. The SHA-256 was recorded at first download and verified against python.org on 2026-11-22 (scripts/native/verify-python-pin.ps1: a fresh download matches, and python.org's detached OpenPGP signature is good and made by signingKeyFingerprint, the Windows-binaries key on https://www.python.org/downloads/metadata/pgp/). Rerun the script before every release and whenever the version changes.

wix-toolset-binaries._comment: BUILD TOOL ONLY: it makes the MSI and is not part of the package. Downloaded with the owner's approval on 2026-11-22 (PK-2). The zip is unsigned and GitHub publishes no digest for it, so the SHA-256 is trust on first use plus an exact size match with the release API (41,297,555 bytes); a compromised toolchain could alter an MSI, which is one more reason the owner signs the final MSI and the release checklist rebuilds it from a fresh download.
